hero.headline: Choose Your Adventure!
hero.tagline: Pick a subject, pick your age, and start learning through play.

subjects.title: Maths
subjects.description: Numbers, shapes, times tables and more — made fun through games and challenges.

categories.title: Counting & Numbers
categories.description: Count objects, learn number order, and practise writing numbers 1–100.

categories.title: Shapes & Patterns
categories.description: Identify 2D and 3D shapes, spot patterns, and explore symmetry.

categories.title: Times Tables
categories.description: Master all times tables from 2× to 12× with speed challenges and beat-the-clock games.

categories.title: Adding & Taking Away
categories.description: Build confidence with addition and subtraction through fun number puzzles.

categories.title: Division
categories.description: Learn to divide with remainders, short division, and real-world problems.

categories.title: Fractions & Percentages
categories.description: Understand halves, quarters, decimals, and percentages through visual games.

subjects.title: Spelling
subjects.description: Word games, spelling challenges, and vocabulary builders for every age.

categories.title: Phonics & Sounds
categories.description: Learn letter sounds, blends, and digraphs through fun listening games.

categories.title: Word Families
categories.description: Group words by pattern — cat, bat, hat — and build spelling confidence fast.

categories.title: Vocabulary Builder
categories.description: Expand your word bank with themed vocabulary games and spelling bees.

categories.title: Tricky Words
categories.description: Tackle the words that don't follow the rules — practise until they stick!

subjects.title: Reading
subjects.description: Stories, comprehension, and phonics adventures — with read-aloud support.

categories.title: Storytelling
categories.description: Enjoy interactive stories with characters, choices, and fun endings. Tap the speaker to hear it read aloud!

categories.title: Comprehension
categories.description: Read passages and answer questions to build understanding and inference skills.

categories.title: Phonics Adventures
categories.description: Follow Pip the Parrot through phonics adventures — tap any word to hear it spoken aloud.

subjects.title: Science
subjects.description: Animals, plants, experiments and the natural world — discover science through hands-on games.

categories.title: Animal Kingdom
categories.description: Explore habitats, food chains, and animal classification from insects to mammals.

categories.title: Plants & Nature
categories.description: Discover how plants grow, what they need, and how they fit into the natural world.

categories.title: Experiments
categories.description: Run virtual experiments and predict what happens next across physics, chemistry and biology.
